comments.body:
As you said 'A Levels', I'm assuming you're from the UK or another non-EU country? Just be aware that if you come here on a visa, ETH requires you to prove that you have 'sufficient financial means' (at least 21,000 CHF) in your personal bank account.

https://ethz.ch/en/studies/international/after-admission/immigration/visa.html#documents
comments.author: Ittybittykittypi
